title: Understanding Pipe Sizing: Friction Loss and Dynamic Pressure
description: When a main water supply line is undersized, opening multiple fixtures causes a dramatic drop in dynamic pressure. This occurs because forcing water through a pipe that is too small increases velocity and internal friction loss against the pipe walls. Proper pipe sizing balances fluid velocity with required fixture volume, preventing noisy pipes, premature wear, and unexpected pressure drops. Always size main trunk lines according to total fixture units rather than using a uniform small diameter throughout the installation. What is your standard main trunk diameter for a typical two-bathroom residential home?
image_prompt: A professional vertical 9:16 photorealistic close-up shot of a clean domestic water supply pipe installation on a light grey wall in a modern utility room. Featured in the center are two neatly mounted PPR water supply pipes side by side for visual comparison: a larger 25mm (3/4-inch) main trunk line and a smaller 20mm (1/2-inch) branch line, connected with precise green PPR socket-fusion tee fittings and clean brass ball valves. The pipe layout is geometrically accurate, clean, and physically realistic. Soft directional studio lighting highlights the texture of the plastic pipes and polished brass valves. Vertical 9:16 aspect ratio composition, leaving generous clean space in the upper third and lower third for text overlays. Pure visual photograph, absolute zero text, no labels, no diagrams, no arrows, no watermarks, no logos, no fake brand names.
visual_story: The visual presents a side-by-side comparison of a 25mm (3/4-inch) main supply trunk line transitioning into a 20mm (1/2-inch) branch line using clean, professional PPR fusion fittings. Viewers immediately notice the physical difference in pipe diameter and wall thickness. This visual reinforces the concept that main supply lines must carry a higher volume of water to feed branch lines without causing high velocity, excessive friction, and dynamic pressure drops downstream.

on_image_text.callout: Trunk Line vs. Branch Line Sizing
